purpose: Estimate held-mug position with learned image points and explicit camera geometry, replacing the failed direct-XYZ observer only if separately tested gates pass.

data.method: Reuse only the exact 4096 original training recipes, regenerating the two existing RGB views and verifying their recorded image hashes. Sample new development/evaluation poses with the same previously frozen pose distribution and new RNG seeds; the failed observer's 9802 development examples are not reused for selection. Label two mug-axis image points and segmentation/visibility from geometry offline only. Preserve every present and absent example and source hash. These remain posed perception renders, without physics stepping or valid-grasp claims.

network.architecture: Existing BottleKeypointNet encoder/decoder architecture with two heatmaps, foreground mask and visibility; newly initialized mug weights, no warm start or pretrained weights.
network.loss: Unchanged observation_loss: Gaussian image-point cross entropy, foreground segmentation, visibility and image-coordinate loss. Simulator data labels/scoring only; inference accepts RGB and fixed calibration.

training.schedule: Cosine over the one declared fit
training.selection: Complete both checkpoints. Among those passing all development gates, choose lowest midpoint p95 3D error, then lowest maximum, then earlier update. No additional fit, threshold revision or data selection.

inference.method: Require both fixed oblique views to pass confidence. Triangulate each semantic point with the known projection matrices, apply the fixed reprojection/axis/workspace checks, and return the two-point midpoint. No object state, depth, segmentation, robot state, teacher or inverse kinematics enters inference.

evaluation.fresh_synthetic: Generate and test all 512 fresh states once only after a frozen checkpoint passes development and FP32 OpenVINO CPU parity/development checks.
evaluation.exposed_physical_regression: If fresh synthetic perception passes, test all 144 already-exposed saved mug states from the completed visibility diagnostic, with the same gate. No fitting or exclusions. Preserve each refused/failed observation. This is an exposed-state regression, not fresh physical generalization or control.
evaluation.control: No motor integration or new physical controller trial belongs to this protocol. A passing observer still requires a separately declared live-versus-frozen control experiment and fresh physical scenes.

export.device: OpenVINO CPU FP32; record actual hardware and do not claim Intel from this AMD/NVIDIA PC

stop_rule: Stop at the first failed selection/export/fresh-perception/physical-state gate. A complete fit includes both declared checkpoints even when the first fails. Preserve all candidates, data, metrics and source. Do not expose later reserved splits or integrate a failed observer. The previous 9803 reserved evaluation remains unexposed and is not borrowed.
retention: Keep raw RGB shards locally and package all exact compact qpos/exposure recipes, projected labels, segmentation counts, hashes and numerical predictions, representative fixed-index images, both checkpoints and evaluated IR if exported. Never overwrite prior models/evidence. Keep GitHub/HF private and leave final Submit exclusively to the user.
